🔄 Content updated (Published: September 6, 2026 / Previous: August 14, 2026)
Main changes: Additional evacuation shelters have opened. Misugi-dai District Administrative Center is newly added, and Daini-ku District Administrative Center has also begun accepting evacuees.

【Announced September 6, 7:10 PM】 Very heavy rain with thunderstorms is forecast across Saitama Prefecture from the evening of September 6 through September 7. Travel after dark and driving through flooded roads are dangerous. If you live near a river or cliff and feel concerned, please check the hazard map in advance, prepare essentials (food, blankets, etc.), and consider evacuating voluntarily to a shelter.

Hanno City is accepting voluntary evacuees at the following facilities: Hanno Central District Administrative Center, Daini-ku District Administrative Center, Kaji District Administrative Center, Kaji-higashi District Administrative Center, Misugi-dai District Administrative Center, Minami-Kōma District Administrative Center, Agano District Administrative Center, Higashi-Agano District Administrative Center, Haraichiiba District Administrative Center, and Naguri District Administrative Center.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/emergency/11997.html
